verdict.rationale: Daytona's Network Limits docs say each sandbox runs behind a firewall that controls outbound internet access and restricts which external IP addresses and domains it can reach. They also say firewall parameters can be set when a sandbox is created or updated while it is running, which delivers explicit, adjustable egress policy. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the policy syntax (allowlist vs. denylist semantics, CIDR/domain rule format, default posture), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the firewall enforces as claimed.
